variants.cockpit: Star Citizen cockpits differ per ship, but the pilot seat always works the same way: flight information on the visor HUD, ship systems on the multi-function displays and every cockpit button reachable through the interaction mode. The two sticks are the right-hand flight stick and the left-hand thrust stick.
variants.notes: From the game's own files (build 4.8): defaultProfile.xml with the T.16000M dual preset layout_t16000m_dual.xml applied, read from Data.p4k. Columns are the master modes (SCM, NAV) and the operator modes; the cells come from the action maps that are active in each mode (spaceship_weapons / _missiles / _quantum / _scanning / _mining / _salvage) and their joystick defaults. Master mode and the missile and salvage modes have no joystick default in the preset (keyboard). Button numbers: T.16000M (1 trigger, 2 thumb, 3/4 head, 5-16 base). Bindings change between patches.

variants.cockpit: Every Elite Dangerous ship shares the same HUD and panel system; the ships differ in seat position, canopy view and in the number of crew seats. The default HOTAS layout puts flight and weapons on the stick and thrust, power, FSD and ship functions on the throttle and its base switches.
variants.notes: From the game's preset ControlSchemes/ThrustMasterHOTASWarthog.binds (Odyssey client). Columns: normal flight (hardpoints in), combat (hardpoints out, combat HUD), analysis HUD (scanners, FSS / DSS), supercruise and landing (gear down). Rows marked 'FSS open' / 'DSS probe view' are the preset's binds inside the Full Spectrum and Detailed Surface Scanners. Physical names follow JoyPro's Warthog catalog. The game has no dual-stick preset; other presets (X52, X56, T.16000M) differ.

variants.cockpit: X4 ships are flown from a cockpit (S and M) or from the captain's chair on the bridge (L and XL); the flight controls are the same for all of them. The preset gives the right stick steering and weapons and the left stick thrust, strafing, boost and the drive modes.
variants.notes: From the preset libraries/inputmap_defaults_t16000m_fcs_spacesimduo.xml (catalog 08): joystick slot 1 is the right stick, slot 2 the left. Columns: flight, travel mode, scan mode and long-range scan mode (left hat); weapons only fire in flight, the long-range pulse is charged on the trigger. Weapon groups, autopilot and countermeasures stay on the keyboard or the radial menu. T.16000M numbering (1 trigger, 2 thumb, 3/4 head, 5-16 base).

overview.text: S and M ships are flown from a cockpit, L and XL ships from the captain's chair; HUD, radar, the two monitors and the radial menu are the same everywhere.
